build_ISAHead: build an ISAHead module for interlaced sparse self-attention semantic segmentation with configurable isa_channels and down_factor
create_SelfAttentionBlock: create a SelfAttentionBlock module that applies self-attention with key query and value projections on input features
run_ISAHead_forward: run the ISAHead forward pass on input feature maps to produce segmentation output with global and local attention
review_ISAHead_forward: review the ISAHead forward method that applies interlaced global and local sparse self-attention on feature tensors
summarize_SelfAttentionBlock_forward: summarize the SelfAttentionBlock forward method that computes self-attention context and projects output through a convolution layer
